technicalChecks.result: All nine selected processed PNGs are non-empty RGBA files with transparent pixels. The shared preparer centered approved artwork without upscaling; rendered XHS cards and responsive course screenshots were inspected separately in runs/day75/verification/.

accepted.review: Bojji's controlled light goblet-squat preparation, the complete kettlebell, and Despa's blank rigid-card planning table connect a short training cycle to recovery without a calendar or number cue.
Three bounded blank rigid cards plus a calm walking preparation communicate planned stimulus and recovery without a date grid, arrow or background.
The revised scene removes the oversized sign prop and retains a safe dumbbell press, controlled sit-to-bench squat and one small flat blank card.
A supported one-arm light dumbbell row and calm seated shoulder relaxation show lower fatigue while preserving movement quality; neither character appears collapsed or in pain.
The revised transition scene keeps only a relaxed walking step, a gentle non-extreme side stretch and one small blank rigid card; race, medal, bottle and mat cues are absent.
The dedicated 4:3 kneeling card-placement scene is distinct from the knowledge-page table composition and keeps Bojji's calm walking separate.
The separate overview scene uses a stable seated light-dumbbell press and a low-bench controlled sit-to-bench position; equipment is complete and safe.
The overview-only supported row and shoulder stretch differ from the knowledge composition while retaining complete equipment and no fatigue or pain cue.
The distinct 4:3 walking-and-gentle-stretch scene contains no stadium, calendar, medal, text or unsafe movement.

rejected.reason: An oversized unrequested A-frame sign-like prop competed with the two training actions and made the sit-to-bench squat read as merely seated.
An A-frame board, unrelated water bottle and yoga mat diluted the simple peak-transition teaching scene.

result: Nine selected source assets passed local visual, alpha, semantic and equipment-safety QA. Rejected candidates and their adjusted prompts remain preserved in image-request-log.json.
